scriptLines: source(output(location_id as integer, abonne_id as integer, station_depart as integer, station_arrivee as integer, debut as timestamp, fin as timestamp, montant as decimal(6,2), modifie_le as timestamp), allowSchemaDrift: false, validateSchema: false, store: 'azureblobfs', format: 'parquet', fileSystem: 'raw', folderPath: $inputPath) ~> RawLocations

RawLocations derive(abonne_pseudo = sha2(256, concat($salt, toString(abonne_id))), batch_id = $batchId, validite_ok = !isNull(location_id) && !isNull(debut) && !isNull(montant) && montant >= 0 && (isNull(fin) || fin >= debut) && !isNull(station_depart) && !isNull(station_arrivee)) ~> DQColumns
DQColumns split(validite_ok, disjoint: false) ~> SplitQuality@(ValidRows, InvalidRows)
ValidRows window(over(location_id), desc(modifie_le, true), seq = rowNumber()) ~> RankVersions
UniqueVersions select(mapColumn(location_id, abonne_pseudo, station_depart, station_arrivee, debut, fin, montant, modifie_le)) ~> SilverColumns

SetUpsert sink(allowSchemaDrift: false, validateSchema: false, store: 'azureblobfs', format: 'delta', fileSystem: 'curated', folderPath: 'locations_delta', keys: ['location_id'], insertable: false, updateable: false, upsertable: true, deletable: false, mergeSchema: false, optimizedWrite: false, autoCompact: false, vacuum: 0, skipDuplicateMapInputs: true, skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SilverDelta

InvalidRows sink(allowSchemaDrift: true, validateSchema: false, store: 'azureblobfs', format: 'parquet', fileSystem: 'staging', folderPath: 'quarantine/locations/' + $batchId, skipDuplicateMapInputs: true, skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Quarantine
